data.long_meaning: The name Sachi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sachit', meaning 'consciousness'. It is also associated with the Goddess Sachidevi, who is known to bestow fortune, prosperity, and joy upon her devotees. The name Sachi carries the meaning “Fortune, Prosperity, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Hindi. Parents who choose Sachi usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, prosperity, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
